ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMBRANCH] AS
BEGIN

WITH BranchSK AS (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(BranchSK),0) RN  from DW.DimBranch )

,Branch_AREA AS (
SELECT  DISTINCT
BB.BranchId AS BranchID
,BBGB.BranchGroupId
,BB.BranchName AS BranchName
,NULL AS BranchDescription
,BBGD.BranchGroupDescription AS Area
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,BBGB.BranchRelatedRegionTypeId
FROM BNKM.Branch BB
LEFT JOIN BNKM.BranchGroupBranch BBGB ON  BB.BranchId = BBGB.BranchId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.BranchGroupDescription BBGD ON BBGB.BranchGroupId = BBGD.BranchGroupId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
WHERE BB.FinancialInstitutionId IN ('CBC01','CBC02') AND
BBGB.BranchRelatedRegionTypeId = 'Branch Area'
)

,Branch_REGION AS (
SELECT  DISTINCT
BB.BranchId AS BranchID
,BB.BranchName AS BranchName
,NULL AS BranchDescription
,BBGD.BranchGroupDescription AS Region
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,BBGB.BranchRelatedRegionTypeId
FROM BNKM.Branch BB
LEFT JOIN BNKM.BranchGroupBranch BBGB ON  BB.BranchId = BBGB.BranchId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.BranchGroupDescription BBGD ON BBGB.BranchGroupId = BBGD.BranchGroupId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
WHERE BB.FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01' AND
BBGB.BranchRelatedRegionTypeId = 'Branch Region'
)

,Branch_ALL AS (
SELECT  DISTINCT
BB.BranchId AS BranchID
,BB.BranchName AS BranchName
,NULL AS BranchDescription
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
FROM BNKM.Branch BB
LEFT JOIN BNKM.BranchGroupBranch BBGB ON  BB.BranchId = BBGB.BranchId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.BranchGroupDescription BBGD ON BBGB.BranchGroupId = BBGD.BranchGroupId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
--WHERE BBGB.BranchRelatedRegionTypeId IS NULL
--WHERE BBGB.BranchRelatedRegionTypeId NOT IN ('Branch Region','Branch Area')
)

,TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH AS (
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN  FROM BranchSK) AS BranchSK
    , * FROM ( 
        SELECT DISTINCT
        BALL.BRANCHID
        ,BALL.BranchName
        ,BALL.BranchDescription
        ,AR.Area
        ,REG.Region
        ,BALL.BankSK
        ,1 AS CurrentIndicator
        ,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
        ,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
        ,0 AS WorkFlowId
        ,0 AS TaskRunId
        ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
        FROM Branch_ALL BALL
		LEFT JOIN Branch_AREA AR ON AR.BranchID = BALL.BranchID AND AR.BankSK = BALL.BankSK
		LEFT JOIN Branch_REGION REG ON REG.BranchID = BALL.BranchID AND REG.BankSK = BALL.BankSK


)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH FROM TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH;

WITH
TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     BranchID
    ,BranchName
    ,BranchDescription
    ,Area
    ,Region
    ,BankSK
    )) HASHROW, BranchID,BankSK 
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH
) 
,
TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH_TGT AS
(SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BranchID ,BranchName ,BranchDescription ,Area ,Region ,BankSK)) HASHROW, BranchID,BankSK FROM DW.DIMBRANCH WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1),

TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH_DELTA AS
(
    SELECT	
        SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
        ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
        ,ISNULL(SRC.BranchID,TGT.BranchID) AS BranchID
        ,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
        ,CASE
            WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
            WHEN TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.BranchID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH_SRC SRC
    FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH_TGT TGT
    ON	SRC.BranchID = TGT.BranchID
    AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.BranchID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH_DELTA;

--------UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
    ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
    ,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DIMBRANCH TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.BranchID = TGT.BranchID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH SRC ON SRC.BranchID = TGT.BranchID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1;

INSERT INTO  DW.DIMBRANCH
    (BranchSK
    ,BranchID
    ,BranchName
    ,BranchDescription
    ,Area
    ,Region
    ,BankSK
    ,CurrentIndicator
    ,ValidStartDate
    ,ValidEndDate
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm)
SELECT
    BranchSK
    ,SRC.BranchID
    ,BranchName
    ,BranchDescription
    ,Area
    ,Region
    ,SRC.BankSK
    ,CurrentIndicator
    ,ValidStartDate
    ,ValidEndDate
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMBRANCH_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.BranchID = SRC.BranchID  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK  AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
GO
